caveats: Official WFS does not implement offset paging. Requests omit count/startIndex and require actual members to equal numberMatched.

Truncated, malformed, general or mismatched exception responses remain unavailable. Exact GetParcel absence is recognized only from a complete OWS1.1 missing-parcel message matching the requested reference and zone.
All runtime query methods share one request slot because simultaneous public WFS reads reproduce connection resets.
